owners.label: Angry Cosmos
owners.description: During the Resonance Liberation Cosmos Rave, when Encore's HP is above 70%, DMG dealt is increased by 10%.

owners.label: Woolies Cheer Dance
owners.description: When Resonance Skill Flaming Woolies or Resonance Skill Cosmos - Rampage is cast, Encore's Fusion DMG Bonus is increased by 10% for 10s.

owners.label: Thermal Field
owners.description: Encore generates a Thermal Field centered around skill target, with a radius of 3m. Targets inside the Thermal Field are continuously burned, suffering Fusion DMG equal to 176.76% of Encore's ATK every 1.5s for 6s.

owners.label: Wooly's Fairy Tale
owners.description: When Basic Attack hits a target, Encore's Fusion DMG Bonus is increased by 3%, stacking up to 4 time(s) for 6s.

owners.label: Sheep-counting Lullaby
owners.description: Encore additionally restores 10 Resonance Energy when casting Basic Attack Wooly Strike or Resonance Skill Energetic Welcome. This can be triggered once every 10s.

owners.label: Fog? The Black Shores!
owners.description: The DMG multiplier of Heavy Attack Cloudy Frenzy and Heavy Attack Cosmos Rupture is increased by 40%.

owners.label: Adventure? Let's go!
owners.description: Heavy Attack Cosmos Rupture increases the Fusion DMG Bonus of all team members by 20% for 30s.

owners.label: Hero Takes the Stage!
owners.description: Resonance Skill DMG Bonus is increased by 35%.

owners.label: Woolies Save the World!
owners.description: During Resonance Liberation Cosmos Rave, Encore gains 1 stack(s) of "Lost Lamb" every time she deals damage, each stack increasing her ATK by 5% for 10s, stacking up to 5 time(s).
